name: timer
title: Timer
description: A countdown or stopwatch timer with a segmented digit display and start/pause/resume/reset controls.

props.name: autoStart
props.description: Whether the timer should start automatically

props.name: countdown
props.description: Whether the timer should countdown, decrementing the timer on each tick.

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the timer parts

props.name: interval
props.description: The interval in milliseconds to update the timer count.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Function invoked when the timer is completed

props.name: parts
props.description: Time parts to render as digit segments, in order.

props.name: startMs
props.description: The total duration of the timer in milliseconds.

props.name: targetMs
props.description: The minimum count of the timer in milliseconds.

props.name: translations
props.description: Specifies the localized strings that identifies the accessibility elements and their states

events.name: onTick
events.description: Function invoked when the timer ticks

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: A stopwatch timer counting up from zero, showing minutes and seconds.

examples.title: Countdown
examples.source:
import Timer from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/timer/timer.marko";

<Timer countdown targetMs=0 startMs=(5 * 60 * 1000) parts=["minutes", "seconds"]/>
examples.description: Pass `countdown` with a `startMs` and `targetMs` to count down instead of up.

examples.title: Days / hours / minutes / seconds
examples.source:
import Timer from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/timer/timer.marko";

<Timer
  countdown
  targetMs=0
  startMs=(2 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)
  parts=["days", "hours", "minutes", "seconds"]
/>
examples.description: The `parts` prop controls which time segments are rendered, in order.

examples.title: Controlled parts
examples.source: import Timer from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/timer/timer.marko"; import type * as timerMachine from "@zag-js/timer";
examples.description: Swap the `parts` array at runtime to change the displayed segments live.
